findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1 instead of 0, so every existing `wait_exponential_jitter` user now gets a minimum wait of 1 second.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, jitter=0)` or any config whose computed wait falls below 1s, with no `min` passed. The return `max(max(0, self.min), ...)` clamps the result up to 1, so waits shorter than 1s are silently lengthened. Callers see slower retries and changed timing; the previous behavior floored at 0.
